items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: it was my first jazz experience hearing the Quartet

ctx.x: That was in Auckland, in New Zealand, and I guess it was the time when a worldwide hit was “Take Five.” And I was in between classical piano studies, which I wasn’t too interested in, and trying to figure out what to do with music. And there was “Take Five” and that was very interesting. And they were doing a world tour at the time, I think this would have been ’61, something like that. And anyway they came out and I had great seats and it was my first jazz experience hearing the Quartet, but mostly you know…
At that point had you had experience with making up music at the piano, not attached necessarily to the page in front of you?
